regime_context: The Canada/TSX thematic detector shows Big Banks as the leading momentum theme with broad participation (breadth 1.0) but significant crowding (z=1.36). Eligible themes are broad (11 of 16) and no single narrative dominates. The only validated edge is the absolute-trend gate for drawdown/shake-out control; momentum ranks are a focus lens, not a return forecast. The rotation signal is display-only and does not point to a confirmed handoff.
emerging_watch: Base Metals & Copper — challenger to Big Banks in the rotation radar (margin 0.615), but low durability (0.51) and breadh (0.222) signal weak cohesion. If durability stays below 0.6 and breadth below 0.5 for 10 days, the challenger hypothesis is discarded.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks remain the leading momentum theme and pass the absolute-trend gate (validated risk control). Durability (0.74) and full breadth suggest coherent participation, but the crowding flag (z=1.36) only counsels downsizing, not fading. Given that momentum is not predictive, this lean is strictly a conditional stay-with-trend unless the gate or durability breaks.
theses.dissent: Crowding could trigger a sharp liquidation if sentiment turns, and momentum has no forward return edge; the high thematic weight (0.25) and low r10 (0.0031) leave the theme vulnerable to mean reversion despite the trend.

falsifier.text: The absolute-trend gate flips to ineligible (trend break), or durability drops below 0.5 and breadth narrows sharply within 10 trading days.

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Utilities pass the trend gate with moderate durability (0.62) and solid breadth (0.77), and are not crowded (z=0.07). Their defensive profile offers a non-correlated complement to the crowded banks theme, consistent with the risk-control mandate of the gate.
theses.dissent: Momentum score is weak (rank 6, score 0.17) and the Hurst tag is mixed; the thesis rests entirely on the trend discipline avoiding drawdowns, which could underperform if a mean‑reverting macro shock hits the sector.

falsifier.text: The absolute-trend gate deems Utilities ineligible, or durability falls below 0.5 and breadth contracts.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
